filter.smart_filter_extras.items.name: Item List
filter.smart_filter_extras.items.tooltip:
Matches any of the selected items (up to 256).
In variant mode an entry only matches that exact variant (e.g. a Potion of Healing).

Click: add or remove · Right click: remove
Double click: pick it and save
Shift + click / right click: add / remove everything shown
filter.smart_filter_extras.item_tag.name: Item Tags (Multi)
filter.smart_filter_extras.item_tag.tool:
Matches items in any of the ticked item tags, e.g. #c:ingots and #c:gems.
Each tag matches like the built-in Item Tag filter.
Hover a tag to see what's in it; use the slot to find the tags an item has.
filter.smart_filter_extras.block_tag.too:
Matches items that place a block in any of the ticked block tags, e.g. #minecraft:mineable/pickaxe.
Only block items can match. Seeds and redstone dust count as block items (they place crops and redstone wire).
Hover a tag to see what's in it; use the slot to find the tags a block belongs to.
filter.smart_filter_extras.fuel.name: Fuel Value
filter.smart_filter_extras.fuel.tooltip:
Compares an item's furnace burn time, in ticks.
One smelted item takes 200 ticks; coal burns for 1600.
> 0 matches any fuel, = 0 anything that isn't fuel.
smart_filter_extras.gui.variants_tooltip:
